posts.title: Listening Glossary
posts.description: I’m proud to have written an entry, ‘Classed Listening’, for this upcoming book on Silver Press, edited by the brilliant Hannah Kemp-Welch. Talking and writing about class is not easy. posts.title: Sounding the Shadows album on YYAA
posts.description: YYAA008: Simon James, Sounding the Shadows Structural resonances and architectural fantasies performed at the RIBA Gallery in Portland Place, London. Using Buchla Electric Music Box, Wingie resonator, contact mics and a transducer to interact with airborne and structural borne sound from the gallery itself.
